title: The LLM Inference Stack
blurb: How a forward pass became an engineering discipline. Read in order: memory first, then precision, then decoding.

anchors.note: Removes the quadratic memory cost by never materialising the attention matrix. Everything after this assumes it.
The rewrite that actually saturates the GPU. Same idea, better work partitioning.
Applies OS-style paging to the KV cache. This is the paper vLLM is built on.
Showed 8-bit inference can be lossless if you handle outlier features separately. Started the quantisation era.
One-shot post-training quantisation to 3-4 bits. No retraining, which is why it spread so fast.
Migrates quantisation difficulty from activations to weights, making 8-bit work where it previously did not.
Protects the small fraction of salient weights instead of quantising uniformly. Strong accuracy at 4 bits.
Decode several tokens per step with a cheap draft model, verify with the big one. Latency without accuracy loss.
Speculative decoding without a separate draft model — extra heads on the model you already have.
